prompt: texinfo-format-region missing closing brace error message
answer:
`texinfo-format-region` reports a missing closing brace as:

**“Unbalanced parentheses”**

It does this because it checks brace mismatches as though they were parentheses. Switch to the `*Info Region*` buffer; the cursor will be just after where the error was detected.
